# has occupation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOccupation`](gmeow-hasOccupation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOccupation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a person to an occupation they hold or have held. Non-functional — a person may have several occupations over time.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) -> [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasOccupation`](gmeow-hasOccupation.md) from [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) to [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to relate a person to an occupation or job role they hold or have held — distinct from the skills that role exercises.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an individual competency (that is [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md)) or a qualifying credential ([`gmeow:holdsCredential`](gmeow-holdsCredential.md)); an occupation is the role, not the ability nor the certificate. Avoid forcing one — a person may hold several over time.

### How to use

- Assert the person → occupation triple; record temporal scope with statement-layer gmeow:validFrom/validUntil where the occupation has start and end, and attach external classification codes through [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](gmeow-occupationClassification.md) on the occupation itself.

### Examples

- ex:alice [`gmeow:hasOccupation`](gmeow-hasOccupation.md) ex:nurse.
